svg.title: Hopping along a chain of accounts
svg.desc: An agent finds the chains an account takes part in, traces one chain hop by hop with anomaly_propagation_in_chain, and asks extend_chain where the run continues. On the right, the accounts in delta space: the chain is drawn hop by hop, the four anomalous hops light up, and the suggested extension appears as a dashed edge. Distance from the centroid is real; angles are illustrative.
svg.text: Four anomalous hops in a row, on the same dimension.
